title: The Nihilist Reading Of Reapers (Mass Effect) #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in Reapers (Mass Effect) — it is manufactured for it. The Reapers are a fictional fleet of sentient starships that serve as the main antagonists of the Mass Effect trilogy. Within the series, the Reapers are cosmic horrors that cause galactic-level mass extinctions every fifty-thousand years.

Reapers (Mass Effect) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. As part of their marketing campaign for Mass Effect 3, BioWare set up a Twitter account named AllianceNewsNetwork in November 2011. Kotaku's Gergo Vas considered Shepard's multiple encounters with the Reapers to be some of the original trilogy's most iconic moments.
